name: Mesa School of Business
one_liner: Mesa School of Business offers a 12-month business program in Bangalore focused on startup leadership, hands-on building, and entrepreneurship.
what_you_sell: A 12-month full-time, residential Post Graduate Program (PGP) in Startup Leadership & Entrepreneurship.
target_group: Mesa targets venture-backed startups and growth-stage companies with 20 to 500 employees looking to hire for founder's office, product, and growth roles. A good prospect is an actively scaling Indian startup that values practical building experience over traditional MBA degrees. A bad prospect is a large, highly matrixed enterprise with rigid traditional hiring requirements.
b2c_note: Mesa School of Business has a business side consisting of hiring partner startups and VC firms that recruit graduates, evaluate startup pitches, or participate in campus hackathons and live projects.
who_uses_it: Students enrolled in the PGP program learning business, AI tools, and sales while building ventures.
who_pays_for_it: Individual students who pay tuition fees for the PGP program.
who_buys_it: Fast-growing startups and VC firms looking to hire candidates for founder-facing roles or evaluate student ventures for investment.
_claims_to_check: Claims an average placement CTC of 26 Lakhs and a 2.8X average CTC jump.
Claims 58% of students are placed in founder-facing roles.
Claims active partnerships with 500+ partner startups and 100+ VCs on campus.
Claims access to a 5 Crore in-house incubator fund.
Implies students launch 3 real AI products and gain 100 loyal customers in 3-4 weeks.
